messages:
maya: heads up — noticed a weird gap in the trace flamegraph around 12:00-12:30, a bunch of child spans show up without parents
sam: looking now. storage shows a spike in orphaned-span writes around the same time :thinking_face:
ops-bot: alert: trace-graph-gap-rate > 0.5% for service=ingest (12:02 -> 12:25)
maya: screenshot posted in thread: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/trace/REDACTED
leo: grabbing collector logs for that window. early sign: `parent_ref: true` present on children but DB queries return 404 for parent id
ingest-svc: log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-20T12:03:12Z] span_id=0xabc parent_id=0xdef parent_ref=true delay_ms=3240
[2026-03-20T12:05:01Z] span_id=0xabd parent_id=0xdef parent_ref=true delay_ms=125000
```

prateek: storage config note: hot retention currently `retention.hot_days=1.5` (36h) per config-service (last changed 2026-02-28)

maya: collector/ingest code assumes parent references are valid for up to 72h (old comment in exporter settings) — digging up config
ingest-svc: collector config snippet:
```
exporter.parent_reference_ttl: 72h  # default from ingestion team
```

sam: ah — mismatch. producer assumes 72h, hot store evicting at 36h. If children are delayed >36h (rebalance, backpressure), parents can be gone
leo: did anything cause increased child delays? any infra changes around 11:30-12:00?
maya: saw a short kafka consumer rebalance + modest traffic burst -> some spans landed 50-90m late for a subset of partitions
sam: reproduced locally by replaying delayed children: parent missing in DB -> children appear as independent roots in console -> console graph loses parent edges
prateek: mitigation options: 1) bump hot retention to align with 72h, 2) change collector to drop parent_ref if parent older than storage TTL, 3) make console show a badge for "parent aged out" so it's less noisy
maya: prefer storage retention bump first as it's safest for debugging and preserves full graphs for longer
ops-bot: created ticket INF-8421: investigate parent/child TTL mismatch and mitigations
sam: i can push a retention bump to 4 days to hot store in ~10m and watch the effects (will monitor disk/compaction)
leo: also filing a UX ticket to display an explicit note when parent lookup returns 404 instead of silently showing roots (INF-8422)

prateek: temporary dashboard query added to help triage: `sum(parent_missing_count)/sum(total_spans)` by service

maya: thanks — rolling bump now would confirm hypothesis quickly. please post metrics after ramp
sam: bump applied at 12:40. watching orphan rate and storage iops
leo: also adding unit test for collector to avoid assuming producer/store TTL alignment in future
maya: update: orphan rate back to baseline by 12:58, dashboards look healthy again :tada:
sam: follow-ups: 1) INF-8421 will propose final TTL alignment and config validation, 2) INF-8422 for console UX, 3) add parent-missing metric to default SLOs
maya: closing thread once tickets have owners. thanks all for the quick turnaround
